verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I have this thirst
Only You can satisfy
My heart it burns
With an all-consuming fire

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
I search and seek
But You're never hard to find
The more of You I see
The more that I desire

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I need You
More than the air that I breathe
You've captured my heart
Every beat
You're pulling me closer

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
There is no one else
There is nothing like Your love
With every taste I get
Jesus, I can't get enough

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
I need You
More than the air that I breathe
You've captured my heart
Every beat
You're pulling me closer

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
I need You
All that I am at Your feet
To pour out my love
And to praise You
Over and over

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
The more I know You
The more I want to
And I can't get enough

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
You're all that I want
You're all that I need
You're my heart's desire
You're my everything
